# Load the spreadsheet
file_path = '/mnt/data/spreadsheet/395-36/1_395-36_init.xlsx'
xls = pd.ExcelFile(file_path)

# Read the necessary sheets
# 'Main unique ID' content preview shows it might not have a header (starts with 7, 8, 9...)
df_main = pd.read_excel(xls, sheet_name='Main unique ID', header=None)
df_getting = pd.read_excel(xls, sheet_name='Result what i am getting')

# Extract the IDs from the first column of 'Main unique ID'
main_ids = df_main.iloc[:, 0].tolist()

# The 'Result what i am getting' sheet has 'Unique ID' as the first column.
# We want to build the result based on the order of 'Main unique ID'
final_rows = []
for uid in main_ids:
    # Check if this ID exists in the 'getting' dataframe
    match = df_getting[df_getting['Unique ID'] == uid]
    if not match.empty:
        # Add the existing row
        final_rows.append(match.iloc[0])
    else:
        # Create a new row with only the Unique ID filled
        new_row = pd.Series(index=df_getting.columns, dtype='object')
        new_row['Unique ID'] = uid
        final_rows.append(new_row)

# Create the final dataframe
df_final = pd.DataFrame(final_rows)

# Include any IDs that were in 'getting' but NOT in 'main' to ensure no data loss
main_id_set = set(main_ids)
getting_only = df_getting[~df_getting['Unique ID'].isin(main_id_set)]
df_final = pd.concat([df_final, getting_only], ignore_index=True)

# Write to the output path in a new sheet 'MyResult' as requested by answer_position
with pd.ExcelWriter('/mnt/data/outputs/395-36_0_d9ed1af1/1_395-36_output.xlsx') as writer:
    df_final.to_excel(writer, sheet_name='MyResult', index=False)",
